name: Name Of Jesus
overview: The Scriptures reveal the profound significance of the Name of Jesus as both a source of salvation and power. Isaiah foretells His divine titles, emphasizing His role as Savior and Prince of Peace, while Matthew confirms that His name means 'Savior,' highlighting His mission to save people from their sins. The New Testament further demonstrates that believers are empowered through His name, as seen in the authority over evil spirits and the promise that prayers offered in His name will glorify the Father. Additionally, the name of Jesus is central to repentance, baptism, and receiving the Holy Spirit, underscoring its essential place in the believer's life and relationship with God.
